name: GLOWDOWN
title: Glowdown
blurb: Five suits of the night sky, SPARK, ECHO, GIFT and PRISM: match suit or face and shed every card first. Two to eight players.
description: A shedding game with a deck of its own: Nova, Comet, Crystal, Orbit and Eclipse, numbers 1 to 8, SPARK +1, ECHO, GIFT and PRISMs. Match the suit or the face and be first out. Switch on stacking sparks, snap, prisms that pass hands, or draw until you can play. Bots fill empty seats.
author: lokeshmohanty
